name: foldwing
description: Foldwing — draw one line, its mirror has to survive too.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm test && vite build
scripts.ios:sync: VITE_AD_MODE=live npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs live && npx cap sync ios && mkdir -p build && rm -f build/.test-ads
scripts.ios:sync:testads: npm run typecheck && npm test && vite build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs test && npx cap sync ios && mkdir -p build && touch build/.test-ads
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "id=$SIM" -derivedDataPath .build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build >/dev/null && xcrun simctl install "$SIM" .build/ios/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && xcrun simctl terminate "$SIM" com.noqyris.foldwing 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl launch "$SIM" com.noqyris.foldwing
scripts.build:test: npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs test
scripts.build:live: VITE_AD_MODE=live npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs live
scripts.ios:testflight: npm run build:test && npx cap sync ios && mkdir -p build && touch build/.test-ads
scripts.ios:appstore: npm run build:live && npx cap sync ios && mkdir -p build && rm -f build/.test-ads
scripts.release:appstore: npm run ios:appstore && fastlane release_build && npm run ios:testflight && fastlane beta_testads
